about.description: Single-stock perpetual on Gains Network tracking Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR), with pricing referencing Chainlink DON (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Palantir Technologies Inc. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC / DAI / WETH on Arbitrum / Polygon / Base.
